test_title: PYST 2: SSC Stenographer - English (Held On:17 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect speech.**

My friend Ganesh said, “I could solve the biggest problem very easily.”

options.text: My friend Ganesh said that he could solved the biggest problem very easily.
My friend Ganesh said that he can solve the biggest problem very easily.
My friend Ganesh said that he would solve the biggest problem very easily.
My friend Ganesh said that he could solve the biggest problem very easily.

solution:
The correct answer is: **My friend Ganesh said that he could solve the biggest problem very easily.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In indirect speech, the tense of the reported speech is usually shifted back (present tense becomes past tense).
 
• The modal verb "**could**" in the reported speech remains the same in indirect speech.
 
• The pronoun "**I**" in the reported speech changes to "**he**" in indirect speech.
 
• The comma and quotation marks are removed in indirect speech.

Hence, **option 4** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1: Incorrect because the verb "**solved**" should be "**solve**" in past tense indirect speech.
 
• Option 2: Incorrect because the modal verb "**can**" should be changed to "**could**" in past tense indirect speech.
 
• Option 3: Incorrect because the modal verb "**would**" implies a conditional situation, which is not present in the original sentence.
